_comment: Row 325. A vanished procfs row reported as ESRCH is absence, not system-wide census uncertainty. Ordinary fixtures use the shipped forward deadline; only four declared expiry controls may shorten it, and the partial-frame control is derived from its loaded wait. The battery covers the procfs classifier, central clamp in both directions, complete AST population, loaded bound, and an accidental opt-in on a historically flaky node. The separate transform-control spec applies the byte-identical procfs transform to an import-only precondition and must ESCAPE. Regex-anchored by row 357 because the loaded partial-frame arrival measurement re-derives the anchored value; each narrow old_regex remains exact-once while literal new preserves the original mutant intent.
subject: vanished procfs rows do not poison group absence and ordinary hunt/reap fixtures cannot shorten the shipped forward deadline

mutants.label: M0 ESRCH from a vanished procfs row poisons the host census again
mutants.old:
try:
            parsed = parse_stat((entry / "stat").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
            # A procfs row can disappear between iterdir() and read_text().
            # Linux reports that completed disappearance as either ENOENT or
            # ESRCH; neither is an unreadable live member of the target group.
            continue
